payload.title: Accessing CMIP6 output with `intake`
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to access and query CMIP6 data using the `intake` library, focusing on data hosted by AWS and Google Cloud. It guides users through browsing the CMIP6 catalog, selecting data of interest, and concatenating experiments in time, including calendar conversions. The notebook emphasizes efficient data handling without local storage and addresses challenges like aligning calendars across datasets.
